CHAT-SEC-1.note: chat sessions owned by their creator principal (user:/key:); owner predicate + restrictive RLS; unowned = admin-only audited routes; frontend filters to own

CHAT-SEC-2.note: message DELETE hard-deletes the row (owner, or admin via audited admin route) and removes the session transcript from the index (queued / 503 when it cannot)

CHAT-SEC-3.note: hourly beat task purges sessions idle past ttl_days (pinned/held kept) in bounded batches, transcript purge queued first; ttl_days settable via PATCH

_new_findings: chat folders (create/list/delete) and move_session_to_folder are in-memory only (ChatService._folders): not durable or multi-replica
POST /chat/sessions/{id}/messages/{mid}/feedback mutates an in-memory copy only; in DB mode feedback is never persisted
ChatService.run_goal reads the session with the sync in-memory get_session, so in DB mode a session's agent_id is ignored for GOAL turns
openapi.json is not regenerated by the chat changes (also stale for CHAT-KB routes)
